## Testing checklist

Per CONTRIBUTING.md, all of the following must pass before submitting:

- [ ] Skill loads without errors
- [ ] Workflow steps are deterministic and testable
- [ ] Evaluation suite covers key scenarios (performance and trigger tests)
- [ ] Manual testing confirms expected behavior
- [ ] Documentation is accurate and complete
- [ ] Updated GLOSSARY.md if introducing new domain terms
- [ ] Created ADRs in `docs/adr/` for hard-to-reverse decisions
